faqs.question: Is Propose Day on 7 or 8 February in 2027?
faqs.answer: 8 February. In 2027 Rose Day falls on Sunday 7 February and Propose Day on Monday 8 February, the second day of Valentine week. If a list you are copying from gives 7 February, it has handed you Rose Day.

faqs.question: Should I write তুমি or তুই to my girlfriend?
faqs.answer: তুমি, unless she already says তুই to you. তুই signals the closeness of people who grew up together and can read as rough if that is not already how you speak. আপনি is respectful and reads as cold in a love note.

faqs.question: What is the safest Bangla line if her family might see her phone?
faqs.answer: "ভালো থেকো। আমি আছি।" (Bhalo theko. Ami achi — "Be well. I'm here.") It is complete, affectionate and explains nothing if someone else reads it over her shoulder.

faqs.question: How long should a Propose Day message in Bangla be?
faqs.answer: Two or three lines. A short message can be closed in one swipe; a long one cannot. Research on shared phones in South Asia documents that women's devices are routinely borrowed and monitored by family, which is what makes length risky rather than romantic.

faqs.question: Can I send the wish in Roman letters instead of Bengali script?
faqs.answer: Yes, and you should if she does not read Bengali script comfortably — a common case for readers who grew up in Bengaluru, Dubai or London. Every line on this page carries a Roman transliteration you can copy as-is.

faqs.question: Is Propose Day the same in Bangladesh and West Bengal?
faqs.answer: The date is the same, the Bengali differs slightly. West Bengal writes সঙ্গে and সন্ধেবেলা where Bangladesh more often writes সাথে and সন্ধ্যাবেলা, and বাবু is a partner's pet name in Kolkata but usually means a small child in Dhaka.

faqs.question: What do I send if we are already dating rather than asking for the first time?
faqs.answer: Proposing again is the honest frame: "আজ আবার প্রপোজ করছি, কারণ উত্তরটা আবার শুনতে ইচ্ছে করছে" (Aaj abar propose korchi… — "I'm proposing again today, because I want to hear the answer again"). It works because it assumes the yes rather than asking for it.

faqs.question: She hasn't replied for an hour — should I send another message?
faqs.answer: No. Send once and leave it. A second message an hour later redraws a shared boundary on your own, and a slow reply often reflects how visible she wants the relationship to be rather than how she feels.

faqs.question: Are these Bengali lines taken from songs or poems?
faqs.answer: No. Every line here is written originally for this page. Modern Bengali song lyrics and poetry are under copyright, so reproducing them on a wishes page is not something we will do.

faqs.question: Can I make a SubhSandesh page in Bengali?
faqs.answer: You can put Bengali text into the message fields and it renders correctly, but the templates themselves are English-language — buttons, prompts and headings stay in English. That is the honest limit today.

faqs.question: Which SubhSandesh template suits Propose Day for a girlfriend?
faqs.answer: Usually the "I love you" page (/love-gf), the most-created template on the platform at 1,138 pages and 24.9% of everything built. The proposal scrapbook (/proposal) is for an actual marriage proposal, which Propose Day usually is not.

faqs.question: Does it matter that Propose Day 2027 is a Monday?
faqs.answer: Yes. Propose Day 2026 was a Sunday; 2027 puts it on a working Monday, so the in-person window is a lunch break or an evening and most of what gets sent that day will be typed rather than said.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Propose Day Wishes for Girlfriend Bangla: Lines You Can Send

Propose Day 2027 is **Monday 8 February** — the second day of Valentine week, not the first. (Rose Day is Sunday 7 February, Valentine's Day Sunday 14 February; weekdays checked against the 2027 calendar.) For a girlfriend: write in **তুমি**, keep it to two or three lines, and send it where only she will open it. That last part is measurable. Across SubhSandesh's 4,567 personalised pages, built since 2026-03-12 across 16 page types platform-wide, 39.9% of creators password-protect the page before sharing it — 1,822 of 4,567, measured 2026-09-17. Below: 13 lines in Bengali script with Roman transliteration and an English gloss, the pronoun rule underneath them, and what to do about the hour after you press send.

## What Propose Day is in Bengali, and when it falls in 2027

Propose Day is the day of Valentine week for saying it out loud — in Bengali **প্রপোজ ডে**, or more traditionally **প্রেম নিবেদনের দিন** (*prem nibedoner din*, "the day of offering love"). It sits between Rose Day and Chocolate Day, and in 2027 it is **Monday 8 February**.

The weekday matters. Propose Day 2026 fell on a Sunday; 2027 puts it on a working Monday, so the in-person window is a lunch break or an evening, and most of what gets sent will be typed.

## Why the pronoun decides whether the line lands

Bengali makes you pick a second person before you say anything. **তুমি** (*tumi*) is the default for a girlfriend: affectionate, equal, unmarked. **তুই** (*tui*) belongs to people who grew up in the same lane; between a couple it reads as either deep closeness or plain rudeness, depending on whether you already speak that way. **আপনি** (*apni*) is respectful, and in a love note it lands like a letter from a bank.

The rule is one line: **send তুমি unless she already says তুই to you.** The pronoun arrives before the sentiment does, so Monday 8 February 2027 is the wrong day to switch register for the first time.

If তুই genuinely is how you two talk, this one is safe:

> **এতদিন বলিনি, আজ বলছি — তোকে ছাড়া কিছু ভাবতেই পারি না।**
> *Etodin bolini, aaj bolchi — toke chhara kichu bhabtei pari na.*
> "I never said it all this time. I am saying it today — I cannot imagine anything without you."

Two spellings place you regionally, and neither is wrong: West Bengal writes **সঙ্গে** (*shonge*, "with") and **সন্ধেবেলা** (*shondhebela*, "in the evening"), Bangladesh more often **সাথে** (*shathe*) and **সন্ধ্যাবেলা** (*shondhyabela*). One endearment actually differs in meaning — **বাবু** (*babu*) is an ordinary pet name for a partner in Kolkata, but in Dhaka it usually means a small child. Use **সোনা** (*shona*) instead if she is Bangladeshi.

## 12 Propose Day wishes for your girlfriend in Bangla

Every line below uses **তুমি**: Bengali script, then Roman transliteration for typing, then the English sense.

### First time you are asking her

> **আজ প্রপোজ ডে, আর আমি আর লুকোতে পারছি না — আমি তোমাকে ভালোবাসি।**
> *Aaj Propose Day, ar ami ar lukote parchi na — ami tomake bhalobashi.*
> "It's Propose Day, and I can't hide it any longer — I love you."

> **অনেক দিন ধরে একটা কথা বলব বলব করে বলা হয়নি — তুমি কি আমার হবে?**
> *Onek din dhore ekta kotha bolbo bolbo kore bola hoyni — tumi ki amar hobe?*
> "For a long time I kept meaning to say something and never did — will you be mine?"

> **ভয় পাচ্ছি, তবু বলছি — আমি তোমার সঙ্গে থাকতে চাই।**
> *Bhoy pacchi, tobu bolchi — ami tomar shonge thakte chai.*
> "I'm frightened, but I'm saying it anyway — I want to be with you."

### When you are already together

> **আজ আবার প্রপোজ করছি, কারণ উত্তরটা আবার শুনতে ইচ্ছে করছে।**
> *Aaj abar propose korchi, karon uttorta abar shunte icche korche.*
> "I'm proposing again today, because I want to hear the answer again."

> **তিন বছর হয়ে গেল, আর আজও তোমার নাম দেখলে ফোনটা তাড়াতাড়ি তুলি।**
> *Tin bochor hoye gelo, ar aajo tomar naam dekhle phonta taratari tuli.*
> "Three years, and I still pick up the phone faster when I see your name." (Change the number.)

> **রোজ সকালে ঠিক করি আজ কিছু বলব না, আর রোজ সন্ধেবেলা তোমাকেই সব বলে ফেলি।**
> *Roj shokale thik kori aaj kichu bolbo na, ar roj shondhebela tomakei shob bole feli.*
> "Every morning I decide I'll say nothing today, and every evening I tell you everything."

### Short enough to survive someone else reading it

> **শুভ প্রপোজ ডে। তুমি আমার সবচেয়ে ভালো খবর।**
> *Shubho Propose Day. Tumi amar shobcheye bhalo khobor.*
> "Happy Propose Day. You are my best news."

> **ভালো থেকো। আমি আছি।**
> *Bhalo theko. Ami achi.*
> "Be well. I'm here."

### When you are in different cities

> **দূরত্বটা মানচিত্রে, আমার মনে নয়।**
> *Durottota manchitre, amar mone noy.*
> "The distance is on the map, not in my head."

> **যেদিন দেখা হবে, প্রথম কথাটা এটাই বলব — ভালোবাসি।**
> *Jedin dekha hobe, prothom kothata etai bolbo — bhalobashi.*
> "The day we meet, this is the first thing I'll say — I love you."

For the long-distance case, the [Train Ticket long-distance page](/train-ticket) makes the gap itself the message.

### When you are not sure she is ready

> **তাড়া নেই। শুধু জানিয়ে রাখলাম, আমি অপেক্ষা করতে জানি।**
> *Tara nei. Shudhu janiye rakhlam, ami opekkha korte jani.*
> "No hurry. I'm only letting you know that I know how to wait."

> **উত্তর আজই দিতে হবে না। কথাটা শুধু তোমার কাছে পৌঁছে দিলাম।**
> *Uttor aaj-i dite hobe na. Kothata shudhu tomar kache pouche dilam.*
> "You don't have to answer today. I only wanted the words to reach you."

## How long is too long, and where to send it

Two or three lines. A Bengali love note rarely has an audience of exactly one, and length is what makes it unreadable in front of other people.

In a SOUPS 2018 study of 199 women across India, Pakistan and Bangladesh, [Sambasivan and colleagues found participants' phones were routinely borrowed and monitored by husbands, brothers, parents and children](https://www.usenix.org/conference/soups2018/presentation/sambasivan), and that the women answered with performative privacy practices, app locks and content deletion among them. A three-line message closes in one swipe; nine paragraphs do not.

Senders also guess the audience badly. Litt and Hargittai's [diary study of 119 adults and 1,200 social network posts](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/2056305116633482) found people imagine either a very broad abstract audience or a narrow specific one — and on a Story that guess is wrong, because her cousins are in it. What each channel costs you:

| Where you send it | Who else can realistically see it | Length that works | SubhSandesh signal |
|---|---|---|---|
| WhatsApp or Instagram DM | her, plus whoever picks up an unlocked phone | 2–3 lines | 39.9% of creators platform-wide lock a page before sharing |
| Instagram Story | every follower, family included | 1 line, no names | 48.9% of views platform-wide are on a phone |
| Public post or tagged photo | everyone, permanently | her name and nothing else | — |
| A private link she opens alone | only whoever holds the link | as long as you like | 6.4h median first-save-to-last-edit, sampled on /love-gf, n=1,138 |

The last row is the honest argument for a page over a text: a link is the only channel that does not punish length. That 6.4-hour median from first save to last edit, sampled on the "I love you" page (/love-gf) with n=1,138, says it plainer than the research does — nobody writes these in one sitting. If you are sending "I love you" rather than "marry me", the [I love you page for a girlfriend](/love-gf) is the better fit, and the most-created thing on the platform at 1,138 pages, 24.9% of everything built.

One caveat, from us rather than found later: these templates are **English-language**. Paste a Bangla line into the message fields and it renders, but the buttons and headings around it stay in English.

## What to do if she doesn't reply for an hour

Nothing. Send once, then leave it.

Following up backfires because the first message already moved a private thing into a space she shares with other people. Ameli and colleagues' 2025 interview study of 47 people in Iran — spouses, informants and couple therapists — describes a [liquid privacy in which the boundary between "mine" and "ours" is renegotiated rather than fixed](https://nms.atu.ac.ir/article_19311_d68e3bc96e6ff5de03e2ee14559ac9db.pdf). A second message an hour later is you redrawing that boundary alone.

A slow reply has a plain cause that is not the answer, too: how visible she wants the relationship to be may not match how visible you want it. In a study of 139 Facebook-using couples aged 17 to 30, [Bouchard, Harrigan and Tobin found relational commitment predicted desired relationship visibility, which predicted what people actually displayed](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/02654075211006788).

If you sent it as a Story, expect a different reception again. A 2024 diary study of 1,270 Instagram posts and Stories reported that [channel ephemerality predicted a less close imagined audience, while imagined closeness tracked with intimate disclosure](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/20563051231224271) — a Story is the wrong shape for the most intimate line you own.

## When a Bangla wishes page is the wrong choice

Three cases, honestly.

If you are actually asking her to marry you, a wishes list is the wrong artefact. That job wants a scrapbook of the two of you ending in a question, which is what the [Will You Marry Me proposal page](/proposal) is built for, YES button and all. Propose Day lines ask her to be with you, not to sign anything.

If she is standing in front of you on 8 February, say it out loud. A link sent from the same room is worse than the same words spoken badly.

And if she does not read Bengali script comfortably — common for readers in Bengaluru, Dubai or London — send the transliteration only. A line she must decode is a line she reads late.

## Sources

- Sambasivan et al., *Performative Privacy Practices on Mobile Phones by Women in South Asia* — SOUPS 2018, 12 August 2018.
- Litt & Hargittai, *The Imagined Audience on Social Network Sites* — Social Media + Society, 24 February 2016.
- Yao, Taylor & Leiser Ransom, *Who's Viewing My Post?* — Social Media + Society, 22 January 2024.
- Bouchard, Harrigan & Tobin, *The use of Facebook in romantic relationships* — J. Social and Personal Relationships, 30 March 2021.
- Ameli, Bicharanlou & Hajjari, *Networked Communication of the Iranian Family* — New Media Studies 11(41), 2025.

failed.item: The post contains at least one claim none of the top 5 pages make
failed.why: Blocker: no live SERP was obtainable. This session's WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200) before Phase 1, and the remediation pass had no working fetch path either, so the top 5 ranking pages for `propose day wishes for girlfriend bangla` were never seen. content/keywords/2026-09-16-propose-100/serps.md measured 11 propose SERPs on 2026-09-16 but none in Bengali, so there is nothing inherited to lean on for this keyword. The fix pass removed the two places that asserted what incumbents print — the opening parenthesis and the first FAQ answer — so the post now states the verified 2027 weekday on its own footing instead of as a correction of pages nobody read. Closes when a SERP can actually be fetched and the Bengali top 5 read; re-check at the next wave on this cluster.

failed.item: Slug short, hyphenated, lowercase, no stop words
failed.why: Blocker: the slug is the exact-match assigned keyword, and the stop word 'for' sits inside the keyword itself. Removing it would break 'Target keyword in H1, metaTitle, slug, and first 100 words', which the same checklist requires, and would discard a slug already verified free in Strapi on 2026-09-17. Nothing the writer controls closes this; it closes only if the batch reassigns this post to a keyword without an internal stop word.

failed.item: 3–6 outbound links, all fetched and verified to contain the cited fact
failed.why: Blocker: journals.sagepub.com returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches, and the remediation pass had no fetch path at all (WebFetch denied, WebSearch exhausted), so nothing could be re-verified, replaced or dropped in favour of a readable substitute. Two of five were read in full: the USENIX SOUPS 2018 PDF and the New Media Studies PDF. The three SAGE items (Litt & Hargittai 2016, Yao et al. 2024, Bouchard et al. 2021) were verified against publisher-supplied abstracts via Crossref and Semantic Scholar, and only abstract-level findings are stated in the body. Closes with institutional access or a green open-access deposit of any of the three; re-check the authors' institutional repositories before the next wave.

auditReport.honestAssessment: An answer engine would have to cite this for the specifics rather than the list: a weekday-verified Monday 8 February 2027 date, an explicit তুমি/তুই/আপনি register rule with the Kolkata-vs-Dhaka বাবু split, and a length-by-channel argument grounded in published research on shared and monitored phones in South Asia. Whether any of that is genuinely absent from the top five is unverified: no live SERP was obtainable this session, so the post no longer claims incumbents print the wrong date and instead shows its own working. Target position 6–10, not 3 — these February SERPs are a news cycle owned by MensXP, Zee, Times Now and Webdunia, whose domain authority is far above ours and who refresh every year, and no amount of editing closes that gap. The weakest part after this pass is still sourcing: three of five citations are abstract-only because SAGE returns 403, and with no fetch path available the fix pass could not upgrade a single one.

Bengali line verification is editorial, not instrumented: there is no Bengali corpus check in this repository, so lines were kept only where grammar, register and idiom could each be defended, and cut otherwise.

cutForCorrectnessOrRegister: তুমি আমাকে সম্পূর্ণ করো ("you complete me") — a calque from English. Grammatical Bengali, but not something a Bengali speaker says.

A rhyming two-line couplet in the register of Bengali romantic verse — cut because anything that scans like published Bengali lyric risks echoing copyrighted material and originality could not be verified.

A তুই imperative ("তুই রাজি হয়ে যা") — তুই imperatives are the highest-risk register in Bengali: warm between people who already use তুই, actively rude otherwise, and a wishes page cannot know which applies.
A Dhaka-colloquial line using কইলাম for বললাম — fine spoken, reads as a typo written, and excludes West Bengal readers.
A প্রেম নিবেদন (formal 'declaration of love') line — correct but ceremonial; reads like a wedding card, not a message.
চাঁদ/moon endearment lines — cliché and flat outside song lyrics, cut for weakness rather than error.
cutForWordCap: তোমাকে ভালো লাগে, এটুকু বলতে আমার এক বছর লেগে গেল। আজ বললাম।
